name: Botanical Metamorphosis Editorial
image_vibe: museum-like floral sculpture, cinematic organic grandeur
image_purpose: high-fashion editorial and couture concept development

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic medium-format portrait of a fictional adult transformed into a living floral sculpture with physical couture texture.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with serene dreamlike gaze and natural skin texture, enveloped in a monumental fully covered gown of sculpted silk and crushed velvet petals transitioning from deep crimson-orange to creamy bone white, with safe decorative oxidized-gold wire filigree over the bodice.
prompt.composition_elements: 2:3 centered portrait with voluminous organic silhouette, arms obscured by petals, dark slate and olive hand-painted canvas backdrop, face in focus and dress receding into shadow.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody Rembrandt lighting carving facial features, soft falloff over petals, still heavy museum-like studio silence, tactile leaf veins and woven threads.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 400 warmth with painterly contrast, realistic physical depth, no digital haze.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 2:3 high-fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman transformed into a living floral sculpture, fully covered monumental gown of sculpted silk and crushed velvet petals, gradient deep crimson-orange to creamy bone white with realistic leaf veins, decorative oxidized-gold wire filigree, serene dreamlike gaze, dark slate and olive hand-painted canvas backdrop, moody Rembrandt light, Hasselblad H6D-100c 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 400 warmth, tactile physical depth, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, sharp wire touching skin, gore, digital haze, CGI, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: botanical couture reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the petal volume, crimson-to-cream palette, wire filigree, centered silhouette, and Rembrandt lighting; keep identity, flowers, fabrics, and backdrop replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the floral metamorphosis concept, physical couture texture, and full coverage. Keep the fictional adult identity and all botanical materials replaceable; use safe decorative filigree.

policy_review.changes: Clarified the subject as a clearly adult fictional woman, made the gown fully covered, and framed the gold wire as safe decorative filigree.
policy_review.notes: Surreal couture is non-graphic and nonsexual.
